items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: But anyway, Rockwell sent Collins out there to get him out of jail.

ctx.x: Yeah, he did -- he did maybe three, I don't know. I'm not too positive about that. But anyway, Rockwell sent Collins out there to get him out of jail. In doing so Collins had tricked Louis, and Louis had signed up with Collins, and -- but in this thing Collins had stipulated that Louis had to pay Rockwell $150.00 a week as long as he worked for --
